metaDescription: Order custom set shot glasses in bulk for events or promotions. Perfect for branded gifts. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Shot glasses sold as sets give you more value per impression — each glass in the set carries your logo, so a single order multiplies your brand exposure. Whether you need a 4-pack for corporate gift bags or a 6-set for bar promotions, sets make distribution easy and memorable. The 1.5 oz Silipint Silishot is a popular choice for its durable, non-breakable silicone construction, ideal for outdoor events or branded giveaways. Customize each glass with screen printing or debossing for a consistent, professional look.
